# Supplied flow artifact — synthetic test input

Audience: first-time small-team coordinators. Task: choose a plan and request account access.

F01 Plans → F02 Create account → F03 Confirm email → F04 Team dashboard.

F01: three plans, prices per user/month; yearly billing is initially selected. Flow text does not specify whether users see the yearly total before submitting.
F02: email and password. This artifact does not document loading, field errors, network loss, back navigation, or whether entered information is retained.
F03: “Check your email”; a Continue action is shown. The artifact supplies neither resend timing nor change-email behavior.
F04: an empty team dashboard with a heading “Start here”. No next action is represented in the supplied flow.

Only this written flow was supplied. No click-through prototype, production site, mobile layout, implementation, analytics, interviews, or observed users are available. Missing paths are documentation gaps or risks to validate, not proof that the product lacks those behaviors.
